title: Charlotte Flair Teases Next Collab with Danhausen: Makeup, "Charl-sen," and More
htmlContent:
Charlotte Flair has conquered championships, shattered records, and outlasted every rival the WWE women's division has thrown at her. But there is one frontier that has proven far more elusive for The Queen: love. So, in a moment that was equal parts vulnerable and hilarious, Flair did what any sensible WWE Superstar would do: she turned to Danhausen.

Flair approached the self-described "very nice, very evil" Superstar with a heartfelt request: use his mystical abilities to help her find true love. Danhausen, known for his jars of teeth, his curses, and his unique brand of chaos, is not typically in the business of matchmaking. And as it turned out, matters of the heart were firmly outside his supernatural jurisdiction.

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by Charlotte Flair (@charlottewwe)

Danhausen Won't Touch Matters of the Heart

Rather than conjuring a love spell for The Queen, Danhausen made his position crystal clear: he does not get involved with matters of the heart. Whether this is a personal boundary or simply beyond the reach of his otherworldly powers remains unclear, but the result was the same: Charlotte Flair's romantic mission was left unfulfilled.

What happened next, however, was far more entertaining than any love potion could have produced. Instead of a heartfelt uncursing, the two Superstars ended up switching robes and having a "Woo" off, a spontaneous battle of Ric Flair's iconic war cry that the internet quickly fell in love with. Danhausen, sporting Charlotte's elaborate robe, and Flair, wrapped in Danhausen's trademark look, delivered one of the more unexpected and delightful moments on WWE social media in recent memory.

Charlotte Reflects on the Viral Moment

The fun did not end with the video. On Monday morning, Charlotte Flair took to Instagram Live to chat with fans and reflect on the whole experience. She was candid, enthusiastic, and clearly not done with Danhausen just yet. Flair told fans she is eager to team up with him again for a new video, and she already has her WWE bracelet at the ready for whatever comes next.

"I'm really excited. I asked Danhausen for true love, and it said he took my robe. I want to do another video with him. What should we do? I have my bracelet. I have them off right now." — Charlotte Flair, Instagram Live.

The Queen also floated the idea of a "Charhausen" nickname, a playful mashup of the two Superstars' names that seemed to delight her. Charlotte and Danhausen, as an unofficial duo, have a certain chaotic energy that WWE fans clearly cannot get enough of.

The Makeup Idea That Has Fans Buzzing

During the Instagram Live, Charlotte and her viewers began brainstorming ideas for the next video, and one concept quickly rose to the top: doing a makeup transformation in Danhausen's iconic style. Danhausen is instantly recognizable thanks to his striking black and white face paint, and the idea of Charlotte Flair sitting down to get the full Danhausen treatment, or vice versa, sent fans into a frenzy.

"Oh, I should do Danhausen in makeup. Oh, that's a good one. He was like, and then I end up in his makeup. Oh, that's good, that's good. Oh my god, that would be insane." — Charlotte Flair, Instagram Live.

The concept has a natural appeal. Flair is known for her polished, glamorous aesthetic, elaborate robes, pristine presentation, Queen-level everything. Danhausen is, to put it lightly, her polar opposite in terms of presentation. The contrast alone would make for compelling content, and given how well the robe swap performed online, a makeup collaboration could very well go viral all over again.

Why This Unlikely Pairing Works

On the surface, Charlotte Flair and Danhausen could not be more different. She is a 14-time world champion, the daughter of wrestling royalty, and one of the most decorated athletes in WWE history. He is an eccentric, self-proclaimed villain who collects teeth, curses his opponents, and speaks in his own peculiar dialect of wrestling logic. And yet, somehow, they are comedy gold together.

Part of what makes the pairing work is that both Superstars are willing to be in on the joke. Charlotte's willingness to lean into the absurdity, genuinely asking Danhausen for romantic help, switching robes with him, and workshopping video ideas on Instagram Live shows a self-awareness and humor that fans have responded to warmly. Meanwhile, Danhausen's distinctive energy in interactions with main-event talent only adds to his mystique and mainstream appeal.

What Comes Next for The Queen and Danhausen?

Between her ongoing in-ring pursuits and this blossoming creative partnership with Danhausen, Charlotte Flair is having a notably multifaceted moment in WWE. On one hand, she remains one of the most formidable competitors in the women's division. On the other hand, she is proving that she has genuine range as an entertainer, with a personality that translates well beyond the ring.

As for Danhausen, his star continues to rise in WWE. His appearances, whether brief or extended, consistently generate buzz, and his willingness to engage with talent across the roster makes him one of the most uniquely entertaining figures in the company today.

Whether the makeup video materializes or a whole new idea takes its place, one thing seems certain: the Charlotte Flair and Danhausen collaboration is far from over. The Queen may not have found true love through Danhausen's powers, but she may have found something arguably more valuable in the current WWE landscape. This genuinely funny, organic creative partnership keeps fans coming back for more.
excerpt: Charlotte Flair took to Instagram Live to reflect on her viral robe-swap and "Woo" off with Danhausen, teasing a potential makeup transformation video and a new unofficial duo nickname — "Charl-sen" — as fans eagerly await what the unlikely pair dreams up next.
